# Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(HDAnalyzeR)
library(patchwork)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(UpSetR)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(ggridges)
library(ggfortify)
library(ggConvexHull)
```

```{r}
source("../scripts/functions/functions_disease_analyses.R")
source("../scripts/functions/nice_plots.R")
source("../scripts/functions/run_de_analysis.R")
```

```{r}
select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter
```

```{r}
theme_lordjord93_so <- function(){
  theme_minimal() %+replace%
    theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, family = "sans"),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.text = element_text(size = 18, family = "sans"),
          axis.text.x = element_text(colour ="black", size = 16, family = "sans"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(colour ="black", size = 16, family = "sans"),
          axis.title.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18, family = "sans"),
          legend.title = element_blank(),
          panel.background = element_blank(),
          axis.line = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
          legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "white")
    )
}
```

## Load data

```{r}
metadata <- read_csv("../data/metadata.csv")
data_long <- read_csv("../data/data_long.csv")
data_wide <- read_csv("../data/data_wide.csv")
```

# Dimensionality reduction

## Subcategories

### PCA

#### Baseline

```{r}
input_df <- data_wide |> filter(DAid %in% (metadata |> filter(Timepoint == "Baseline") |> filter(Disease == "HIV"))$DAid)

pca_df <- hd_pca(
  dat = input_df,
  components = 10,
  by_sample = TRUE,
  impute = TRUE,
  seed = 123
)
```

```{r}
pc1 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[1]
pc2 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[2]

p_pca_baseline_subcategory <- pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Subcategory)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`)) +
  # thin grey lines connecting points from the same ID
  labs(
    title = "PCA of HIV samples",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2, 2), "%)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  # Add dashed elipses around each subcategory
  geom_convexhull(aes(fill = Subcategory, colour = Subcategory), alpha = 0.2) +
  theme_hiv()

p_pca_baseline_subcategory

ggsave(
  filename = "pca_baseline_subcategory.pdf",
  path     = "../plots/pdf/pca/",
  width    = 14,
  height   = 7)

ggsave(
  filename = "pca_baseline_subcategory.png",
  path     = "../plots/png/pca/",
  width    = 14,
  height   = 7)
```

```{r}
input_df <- data_wide |> filter(DAid %in% (metadata |> filter(Timepoint == "Baseline") |> filter(Disease == "HIV"))$DAid) |>
  # Filter columns to only contain the significant proteins from de_res_hiv_baseline_healthy
  select(DAid, all_of(de_res_hiv_baseline_healthy |> filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) |> pull(Feature)))

pca_df <- hd_pca(
  dat = input_df,
  components = 10,
  by_sample = TRUE,
  impute = TRUE,
  seed = 123
)

subcategory_colors <- c(
  "Primary HIV Infection"       = "#65A56E",  # teal / blue-green
  "Severely impaired immunity" = "#CD4645",  # mustard yellow
  "More preserved immunity"    = "#E3C35B",  # muted red
  "Elite Controller"           = "#377EB8",  # blue-purple
  "Healthy"                    = "#BDBDBD"   # neutral grey
)

pc1 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[1]
pc2 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[2]

p_pca_baseline_subcategory <- pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Subcategory)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(size = `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`),
    alpha  = 0.7,
    stroke = 0
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of HIV samples",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2, 2), "%)")
  ) +
  geom_convexhull(
    aes(fill = Subcategory, colour = Subcategory),
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = subcategory_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = subcategory_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme_hiv()

p_pca_baseline_subcategory

ggsave(
  filename = "pca_baseline_subcategory_hiv_healthy.pdf",
  path     = "../plots/pdf/pca/",
  width    = 14,
  height   = 7)

ggsave(
  filename = "pca_baseline_subcategory_hiv_healthy.png",
  path     = "../plots/png/pca/",
  width    = 14,
  height   = 7)
```

# Baseline, follow-up and healthy

```{r}
input_df <- data_wide |> filter(DAid %in% (metadata |> filter(Disease %in% c("HIV", "Healthy")))$DAid)

pca_df <- hd_pca(
  dat = input_df,
  components = 10,
  by_sample = TRUE,
  impute = TRUE,
  seed = 123
)
```

```{r}
timepoint_colors <- c(
  "Baseline"  = "#E94849",
  "Follow-up" = "#5F98C6",
  "Healthy"   = "#71BF6E"
)

hiv_panels <- c(
  "Primary HIV Infection",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Elite Controller"
)

plot_df <- pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  # Make ID into character
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) |>
  dplyr::filter(Subcategory %in% c(hiv_panels, "Healthy")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Facet_group = Subcategory,
    # ensure Healthy has a consistent Timepoint label
    Timepoint = ifelse(Subcategory == "Healthy", "Healthy", Timepoint)
  )

healthy_df <- plot_df |>
  dplyr::filter(Subcategory == "Healthy") |>
  dplyr::select(-Facet_group) |>
  tidyr::expand_grid(Facet_group = hiv_panels)

plot_df <- plot_df |>
  dplyr::filter(Subcategory != "Healthy") |>
  dplyr::bind_rows(healthy_df)

plot_df$Facet_group <- factor(plot_df$Facet_group, levels = hiv_panels)


pc1 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[1]
pc2 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[2]

p_pca_split_timepoint <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)
) +

  # 🔹 Filled ellipses (behind everything)
  stat_ellipse(
    data = plot_df,
    aes(
      fill  = Timepoint,
      group = interaction(Timepoint, Facet_group)
    ),
    geom  = "polygon",
    alpha = 0.15,
    colour = NA
  ) +

  # 🔹 Dashed ellipse outlines
  stat_ellipse(
    data = plot_df,
    aes(
      colour = Timepoint,
      group  = interaction(Timepoint, Facet_group)
    ),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  # 🔹 Thin grey paired lines (HIV only)
  geom_line(
    data = plot_df |>
      dplyr::filter(
        Disease == "HIV",
        Timepoint %in% c("Baseline", "Follow-up")
      ),
    aes(group = interaction(ID, Facet_group)),
    colour = "grey70",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  # 🔹 Points (on top)
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Timepoint),
    size   = 3,
    alpha  = 0.7,
    stroke = 0
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~ Facet_group, ncol = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = timepoint_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = timepoint_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of HIV subgroups compared to Healthy",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2, 2), "%)"),
    color = "Timepoint",
    fill  = "Timepoint"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme_hiv()

p_pca_split_timepoint

ggsave(
  filename = "pca_split_timepoint_hiv_healthy.pdf",
  path     = "../plots/pdf/pca/",
  width    = 18,
  height   = 10)

ggsave(
  filename = "pca_split_timepoint_hiv_healthy.png",
  path     = "../plots/png/pca/",
  width    = 18,
  height   = 10)
```

#### Baseline & follow-up

```{r}
input_df <- data_wide |> filter(DAid %in% (metadata |> filter(Disease == "HIV"))$DAid)
```

```{r}
pc1 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[1]
pc2 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[2]

pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Subcategory, shape = Timepoint)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  # thin grey lines connecting points from the same ID
  geom_line(aes(group = ID), color = "grey80", alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of HIV samples",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2, 2), "%)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")
```

```{r}
pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Subcategory, shape = Timepoint)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
 # geom_convexhull(aes(fill = Subcategory, colour = Subcategory), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color = "black", size = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype="dashed", colour= "black", size = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(group = ID), color = "grey80", alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of HIV samples",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2, 2), "%)")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`More preserved immunity` = "#64629A", 
                               `Severely impaired immunity` = "#CC5E5E", 
                               `Elite Controller` = "#529F96", 
                               `Primary HIV Infection` = "#DCAA1F")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values =  c(`More preserved immunity` = "#64629A", 
                                  `Severely impaired immunity` = "#CC5E5E", 
                                  `Elite Controller` = "#529F96", 
                                  `Primary HIV Infection` = "#DCAA1F")) +
  theme_lordjord93_so()
```

## Comparing 3 treatments

```{r}
input_df <- data_wide |> filter(DAid %in% (metadata |> filter(Treatment %in% c("INSTI + Abacavir", "INSTI + Tenofovir", "NNRTI + Tenofovir")))$DAid)
```

### PCA

```{r}
pca_df <- hd_pca(
  dat = input_df,
  components = 10,
  by_sample = TRUE,
  impute = TRUE,
  seed = 123
)

pc1 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[1]
pc2 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[2]
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  mutate(TimeTreatment = paste(Timepoint, Treatment, sep = " - ")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = TimeTreatment, shape = Timepoint)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  # thin grey lines connecting points from the same ID
  geom_line(aes(group = ID), color = "grey80", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of HIV treatment by Timepoint",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2, 2), "%)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")

```

# CVD & Metabolic

```{r}
input_df <- data_wide |> 
  bind_rows(hdba_data) |>
  # Select for proteins in de_results$de_res
  select(DAid, all_of(res_hiv_fu_baseline |> filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) |> filter(abs(logFC) > 0.5) |> pull(Feature)))
```

```{r}
pca_df <- hd_pca(
  dat = input_df,
  components = 10,
  by_sample = TRUE,
  impute = TRUE,
  seed = 123
)

pc1 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[1]
pc2 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[2]
```

```{r}
timepoint_colors <- c(
  "Baseline"        = "#E94849",
  "Follow-up"       = "#5F98C6",
  "Healthy"         = "#71BF6E",
  "Cardiovascular"  = "#FC8D62",
  "Metabolic"       = "#E5C494"
)

hiv_panels <- c(
  "Primary HIV Infection",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Elite Controller"
)

reference_groups <- c(
  "Healthy",
  "Cardiovascular",
  "Metabolic"
)

# ---- Base joined table (KEEP EVERYTHING here) ----
base_df <- pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(
    metadata |> bind_rows(hdba_metadata),
    by = "DAid"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    Timepoint = ifelse(Subcategory %in% reference_groups,
                       Subcategory,
                       Timepoint)
  )

# ---- HIV samples define facets ----
hiv_df <- base_df |>
  filter(Subcategory %in% hiv_panels) |>
  mutate(Facet_group = Subcategory)

# ---- Reference samples duplicated into all HIV facets ----
reference_df <- base_df |>
  filter(Subcategory %in% reference_groups) |>
  tidyr::expand_grid(Facet_group = hiv_panels)

# ---- Combine ----
plot_df <- bind_rows(hiv_df, reference_df)

plot_df$Facet_group <- factor(plot_df$Facet_group, levels = hiv_panels)


p_pca_split_timepoint <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)
) +

  # ---- Filled ellipses (behind everything) ----
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(
      fill  = Timepoint,
      group = interaction(Timepoint, Facet_group)
    ),
    geom   = "polygon",
    alpha  = 0.15,
    colour = NA
  ) +

  # ---- Dashed ellipse outlines ----
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(
      colour = Timepoint,
      group  = interaction(Timepoint, Facet_group)
    ),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  # ---- Paired baseline → follow-up lines (HIV only) ----
  geom_line(
    data = plot_df |>
      filter(
        Disease == "HIV",
        Timepoint %in% c("Baseline", "Follow-up")
      ),
    aes(group = interaction(ID, Facet_group)),
    colour   = "grey70",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    alpha    = 0.6
  ) +

  # ---- Points ----
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Timepoint),
    size   = 3,
    alpha  = 0.7,
    stroke = 0
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~ Facet_group, ncol = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = timepoint_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = timepoint_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of HIV subgroups relative to Healthy, Cardiovascular, and Metabolic disease",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    color = "Group",
    fill  = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme_hiv()

p_pca_split_timepoint

ggsave(
  filename = "pca_split_timepoint_hiv_healthy_cvd_met.pdf",
  path     = "../plots/pdf/pca/",
  width    = 18,
  height   = 10)

ggsave(
  filename = "pca_split_timepoint_hiv_healthy_cvd_met.png",
  path     = "../plots/png/pca/",
  width    = 18,
  height   = 10)
```
